Historical reconstruction: Intel Q2 2026 preview

This article is a historical reconstruction. It uses only information from Intel's Q1 2026 earnings release published on April 23, 2026. It was not written before the actual Q2 earnings release.

Conclusion
Intel guides Q2 2026 revenue to $13.8-14.8 billion. The midpoint is $14.3 billion. This implies about 5% sequential growth from Q1 revenue of $13.6 billion. Guided GAAP diluted EPS is $0.08. Guided non-GAAP diluted EPS is $0.20. Guided GAAP gross margin is 37.5%. Guided non-GAAP gross margin is 39.0%. The source does not provide market consensus. The source does not provide Q2 2025 revenue, so this article does not state a year-over-year growth forecast.

Q1 base
Q1 revenue was $13.6 billion, up 7% year over year. GAAP EPS was -$0.73. Non-GAAP EPS was $0.29. Cash from operations was $1.1 billion. CCG revenue was $7.7 billion, up 1%. DCAI revenue was $5.1 billion, up 22%. Foundry revenue was $5.4 billion, up 16%. Foundry operating loss was $2.4 billion. GAAP loss included $4.1 billion of restructuring and other charges. The CEO said revenue was above expectations for the sixth consecutive quarter.

Core questions
First, why does guided non-GAAP gross margin fall from 41.0% to 39.0%? The release does not explain. Management commentary is needed.
Second, can revenue growth continue? The midpoint implies sequential growth of about 5%. DCAI strength is the key.
Third, can Foundry reduce its operating loss? Q1 showed growth and a large loss. Q2 will show if supply expansion improves profit.

Expectations
Upside: revenue reaches the top of the range; DCAI stays strong; Foundry loss narrows; cash flow improves.
Downside: margin misses; charges continue; trade policy and export controls create risk.

Verification points
Check actual revenue against $13.8-14.8 billion. Check non-GAAP EPS near $0.20. Check non-GAAP gross margin near 39.0%. Check segment growth and cash flow. Check management comments on H2.
reader_questions: 毛利率指引是否随收入在区间内变动？来源只说毛利率和 EPS 指引基于收入区间中点；如果收入落在上限或下限，39.0% 未必成立。因此正文将 39.0% 标为指引基准，而非预测区间。
Q2 GAAP EPS 0.08 与 non-GAAP EPS 0.20 的差距来自哪些调整项？来源未列出 Q2 的重组、股权激励或税务调整明细；正文只引用两个数字，不推测差距构成。
为什么正文不写 Q2 同比增速？因为来源未披露 2025 年第二季度可比收入；若用 2025Q1 代替会形成错误可比。正文只写环比，并明确说明未写同比的原因。

Q1 2026 GAAP 归属 Intel 净亏损 37.28 亿美元，摊薄 EPS -0.73 美元；non-GAAP 归属 Intel 净利润约 15 亿美元，non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS 0.29 美元。

Q1 2026 GAAP 毛利率 39.4%，non-GAAP 毛利率 41.0%；non-GAAP 毛利率同比下降 1.8 个百分点、环比未在来源中直接比较。
Q2 2026 官方指引：收入 138—148 亿美元；GAAP 毛利率 37.5%，non-GAAP 毛利率 39.0%；GAAP 摊薄 EPS 0.08 美元，non-GAAP 摊薄 EPS 0.20 美元；公司注明毛利率与 EPS 指引基于收入区间中点。
Q1 分部收入（含内部交易）：CCG 77.27 亿美元（+1%），DCAI 50.52 亿美元（+22%），Intel Products 合计 127.79 亿美元（+9%），Foundry 54.21 亿美元（+16%），All Other 6.28 亿美元（-33%）。
Q1 分部营业利润：CCG 25.16 亿美元，DCAI 15.42 亿美元，Intel Products 合计 40.58 亿美元，Foundry -24.37 亿美元。
Q1 GAAP 亏损包含重组及其他费用 40.70 亿美元。
Altera 自 2025-09-12 起不再合并，来源明确说明同比比较受影响。
来源未提供市场共识预测，因此本稿不引用共识数字。
